perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage for an improved duration.

perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed while shielding.

enhanced.name: Tilting at Windmills
enhanced.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed for an improved duration while you are shielding.

perks.name: En Garde

enhanced.description: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this Sword do additional damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Whirlwind Blade
enhanced.description: Rapid Sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for an improved duration. Guarding ends the effect.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.

enhanced.name: Counterattack
